text:
alex_prodeng: Heads-up: planning a quiet-window apply for network+IAM changes at 2026-06-15T02:00Z (change window). Release notes: https://redwood/release/2026.06.15
maya_infra: Putting up PR for tf plan now. Need provider pin (hashicorp/aws -> 4.58.0) and module version freeze.
maya_infra: plan snippet:
```
# aws_iam_role.redwood_inference_lambda will be updated
~ resource "aws_iam_role" "redwood_inference_lambda" {
    assume_role_policy = "...old..." -> "...new with sts:AssumeRole for cross-account"
}
``` 
jordan_sre: Noted. Can we do canary in eu-west-1 first? Suggest manual drift check + smoke tests post-apply. Also add a brief outage blurb for support (5-10m expected low impact).
alex_prodeng: yes canary -> eu-west-1 then global. Deploybot, schedule apply at window and hold for manual smoke signoff.
deploybot: @channel SCHEDULED: terraform apply for infra/network at 2026-06-15T02:00Z (thread 1778889990). Will run in serial across AZs. Auto-rollback threshold: if 10% of smoke checks fail, will pause and flag.
ben_ops: What's the rollback playbook? If the iam role change breaks cross-account access we need fast revert.
alex_prodeng: rollback steps (manual):
1) revert module tag to previous release (v2026.06.14)
2) terraform apply -target=module.iam -refresh=false
3) if urgent: re-add old assume_role_policy via CLI
CLI snippet:
```
aws iam update-assume-role-policy --role-name redwood_inference_lambda --policy-document file://old_policy.json
```
sam_platform: Freeze merges to main 30 minutes before window. Also pin the tf-provider in CI in case hash changes. CI snippet:
```
terraform { required_providers { aws = { version = "~> 4.58.0" } } }
```
maya_infra: plan output shows only role trust and a tag change. No route table or sg diffs. I'll run an extra `terraform plan -out=canary.plan` and attach.
alex_prodeng: attaching the canary plan in release tracker. @jordan_sre can you own the smoke checks for eu-west-1? We'll do rollback decision within 10m after apply.
jordan_sre: I'll run the canary tests (connectivity, S3 access from cross-account lambda) and post results. If failures >1, I'll call rollback.
maya_infra: quick note: I've added a tagging migration script to run after canary to avoid drift.
ben_ops: :thumbsup: keep pager on until global rollout completes.
deploybot: EXECUTE NOTICE: will pause for manual approval after eu-west-1 apply. Approvers: alex_prodeng, jordan_sre.
alex_prodeng: Approved. Ready on my side.
jordan_sre: Approved pending green smoke checks.
sam_platform: I've pinned the provider in CI and created a release note entry under 2026.06.15 -> 'network: IAM trust update for cross-account lambda (canary then global)'.
maya_infra: starting canary apply in eu-west-1 now (manual). Will paste apply output on completion.
deploybot: APPLY STARTED: eu-west-1
maya_infra: APPLY SUCCESS: 1 updated (aws_iam_role.redwood_inference_lambda), no other resources changed. Running smoke tests.
jordan_sre: Smoke results: connectivity ok, S3 access ok, cross-account invoke succeeded. All green.
alex_prodeng: Proceed to global rollout in 15m.
maya_infra: global apply started.
deploybot: APPLY SUCCESS: global rollout completed. No incidents reported.
ben_ops: Great work team. Closing thread, will update postmortem if any anomalies show up.
alex_prodeng: thanks everyone. :tada:
